description:
What a generate call can be told to use.

models: the allowed models with credit estimates and settings_schema
(the valid settings keys); is_default marks the default (the account's
saved choice, else Framesail's). Voice and clip models come in families,
each with its own default: pass provider or talking_head for one family.

prompt_sections: sections with entity_backed=false can be overridden
with editable_sections; entity_backed=true sections show the item's own
content (description, prompts, text, brief): change it with the edit
tools.

action.description: models: the allowed models; prompt_sections: the prompt editor's sections

generation.description: script_scan is Analyze Script; *_reference, reference images; voice_block, the voiceover; segment_image, a segment's image; segment_video, a clip; art_style_*_template, the style's template images

provider.description: voice_block: the voice engine (the project's voice_tts_provider)

talking_head.description: segment_video: true for talking head models, false for clips
